1257 is a common year (not divisible by 4).  
295 days back from 1257-11-14:  
Back 14 days → 1257-10-31, back 281 more days → 281 = 31+28+31+30+31+30+31+31+8 → lands in February.  

1257-10-31 minus 281 days:  
Oct (31 days) → Sep 30 (1 day down) → Sep 29 (2 days down) … actually easier:  
From 1257-10-31 subtract 281 days:  
Go to 1257-01-01 is 273 days earlier (Jan 31 + Feb 28 + Mar 31 + Apr 30 + May 31 + Jun 30 + Jul 31 + Aug 31 + Sep 30 = 273 days from Jan 1 to Sep 30, then Oct 31 is 304 days from Jan 1, so 304-273=31? Let’s recalc:  

Days from Jan 1 to Oct 31:  
Jan 31, Feb 28, Mar 31, Apr 30, May 31, Jun 30, Jul 31, Aug 31, Sep 30, Oct 31 →  
31+28=59, +31=90, +30=120, +31=151, +30=181, +31=212, +31=243, +30=273, +31=304.  

So Oct 31 is day 304 of year (non-leap).  
304 − 281 = day 23 of year.  
Day 23 in non-leap: Jan 23.  

Thus 1257-01-23.  

FINAL_ANSWER: 1257-01-23
